description: imap/src/session/auth.rs correctly gates AUTH PLAIN and LOGIN behind a TLS check (!ctx.tls → LOGINDISABLED response). This matches RFC 3501 §6.2.2 and the LOGINDISABLED capability semantics. STARTTLS resets auth_failures to 0 (correct: a new TLS channel is a new authentication attempt context). The authzid == authcid check in plain_finish() prevents impersonation where a client authenticates as user A but claims to act as user B. These are all correct security decisions.
title: decision: IMAP AUTH only permitted after TLS; LOGINDISABLED enforced correctly
